"''I don't care what your name is. Surrender, Bane.|Cad Bane and the marshal|}} A [[Gender|male]] [[Human|human]] '''individual''' worked as a [[marshal]]. During the [[Republic Era]] he shot down the [[Gangster|gangster]] [[Lazlo]] and later encountered the [[Duros]] [[bounty hunter]], [[Cad Bane]], who was an old friend of [[Niro|a deputy]] seeking revenge for the death of his mentor. In [[Showdown in an unidentified city|a stand-off]], Bane gunned the marshal down, much to his friend's dejection. {{Char-stub}} ==Behind the scenes== The marshal first appeared in the animated miniseries ''[[Star Wars: Tales of the Underworld]]'', which episodes were released on [[May 4]], [[2025]].{{SWYouTube|GkywNANueew|Tales of the Underworld | Official Trailer | Available May 4 on Disney+}} He was voiced by [[Imari Williams]]. ==Appearances== *{{TOTU|A Good Turn}} {{1st}} ==Sources== *{{SWYouTube|url=GkywNANueew|text=Tales of the Underworld | Official Trailer | Available May 4 on Disney+}} {{1stm|StarWars.com article}} *{{SW|url=news/tales-of-the-underworld-announce|text=Two Favorite ''Star Wars'' Bounty Hunters are Back for ''Tales of the Underworld''}} *{{InsiderCite|236|Tales of Destiny}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |ka=უცნობი მარშალი }} [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Individuals with he/him pronouns]] [[Category:Males]] [[Category:Marshals]]
